ACCESS_KEYS_ROTATED.condition_description: Periodic rule that flags any active IAM access key whose age exceeds the maxAccessKeyAge parameter (default 90 days). Inactive keys are ignored, and root user keys are out of scope.
ACCESS_KEYS_ROTATED.framework_control_requirement: Checks if active IAM access keys are rotated (changed) within the number of days specified in maxAccessKeyAge. The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if access keys are not rotated within the specified time period. The default value is 90 days.
ACCESS_KEYS_ROTATED.remediation_summary: Rotate the IAM user's active access key before it exceeds maxAccessKeyAge. Create a new access key, update applications/credentials to use it, then delete or deactivate the old key via the IAM console, CLI (aws iam update-access-key / delete-access-key), or Terraform aws_iam_access_key replacement. Remove unused keys entirely.
ACCESS_KEYS_ROTATED.title: Active IAM access keys must be rotated within the configured maximum age

ACCOUNT_PART_OF_ORGANIZATIONS.condition_description: Periodic rule that flags an AWS account that is not a member of AWS Organizations, or whose Organizations management (master) account ID does not match the configured MasterAccountId parameter.
ACCOUNT_PART_OF_ORGANIZATIONS.condition_logic: account.is_part_of_organizations == True AND (parameter.MasterAccountId == null OR account.organizations_master_id == parameter.MasterAccountId)
ACCOUNT_PART_OF_ORGANIZATIONS.framework_control_requirement: Checks if an AWS account is part of AWS Organizations. The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if an AWS account is not part of AWS Organizations or AWS Organizations master account ID does not match rule parameter MasterAccountId.
ACCOUNT_PART_OF_ORGANIZATIONS.remediation_summary: Invite the account into AWS Organizations or accept a pending invitation, then re-evaluate. If MasterAccountId is set, ensure it matches the actual Organizations management account ID. Use the Organizations console, AWS CLI (aws organizations invite-account-to-organization / accept-handshake), or Terraform aws_organizations_organization / aws_organizations_account.
ACCOUNT_PART_OF_ORGANIZATIONS.title: AWS account must be part of AWS Organizations and match the configured master account

ACM_CERTIFICATE_EXPIRATION_CHECK.condition_description: Periodic and configuration-change rule that flags any ACM certificate whose remaining validity is less than the daysToExpiration parameter (default 14 days). ACM-issued certs auto-renew; imported certs do not.
ACM_CERTIFICATE_EXPIRATION_CHECK.framework_control_requirement: Checks if AWS Certificate Manager Certificates in your account are marked for expiration within the specified number of days. Certificates provided by ACM are automatically renewed. ACM does not automatically renew certificates that you import. The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if your certificates are about to expire.
ACM_CERTIFICATE_EXPIRATION_CHECK.remediation_summary: Renew or replace ACM certificates before they reach the daysToExpiration threshold. For ACM-issued certificates ensure DNS or email validation records remain in place so auto-renewal succeeds; for imported certificates, generate a new certificate and re-import via aws acm import-certificate or Terraform aws_acm_certificate. Re-bind the new certificate ARN to ALBs, CloudFront, API Gateway, and other consumers.
ACM_CERTIFICATE_EXPIRATION_CHECK.title: ACM certificates must not be near expiration

ACM_CERTIFICATE_RSA_CHECK.condition_description: Configuration-change rule that fails any ACM-managed RSA certificate whose key length is below 2048 bits.
ACM_CERTIFICATE_RSA_CHECK.framework_control_requirement: Checks if RSA certificates managed by AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) have a key length of at least '2048' bits. The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if the minimum key length is less than 2048 bits.
ACM_CERTIFICATE_RSA_CHECK.remediation_summary: Re-issue or re-import any RSA certificate with a key length below 2048 bits. Use aws acm request-certificate (or Terraform aws_acm_certificate) selecting an RSA-2048 or stronger key, or switch to an ECDSA certificate. Replace the old certificate ARN on all consumers (ALB/NLB listeners, CloudFront, API Gateway, etc.) before deleting the legacy certificate.
ACM_CERTIFICATE_RSA_CHECK.title: ACM RSA certificates must use a key length of at least 2048 bits

ACM_PCA_ROOT_CA_DISABLED.condition_description: Periodic rule that fails any AWS Private CA root CA whose status is anything other than DISABLED. Specific CA ARNs may be exempted via the exemptedCAArns parameter.
ACM_PCA_ROOT_CA_DISABLED.condition_logic: (acm_pca.CA.Type == 'ROOT' AND acm_pca.CA.Status == 'DISABLED') OR acm_pca.CA.Arn IN exemptedCAArns
ACM_PCA_ROOT_CA_DISABLED.framework_control_requirement: Checks if AWS Private Certificate Authority (AWS Private CA) has a root CA that is disabled. The rule is NON_COMPLIANT for root CAs with status that is not DISABLED.
ACM_PCA_ROOT_CA_DISABLED.remediation_summary: Disable AWS Private CA root CAs that are not actively issuing certificates by calling aws acm-pca update-certificate-authority --status DISABLED, or apply Terraform aws_acmpca_certificate_authority.enabled = false. Issue subordinate (intermediate) CAs from the root, then keep the root offline/disabled, exempting only the ARNs in exemptedCAArns.
ACM_PCA_ROOT_CA_DISABLED.title: AWS Private CA root CAs must be disabled

ALB_DESYNC_MODE_CHECK.condition_description: Checks if an Application Load Balancer (ALB) is configured with a user defined desync mitigation mode. The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if ALB desync mitigation mode does not match with the user defined desync mitigation mode. Identifier: ALB_DESYNC_MODE_CHECK Resource Types: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer Trigger type: Configuration changes AWS Region: All supported AWS regions except Asia Pacific (New Zealand), Asia Pacific (Thailand), Mexico (Central), Asia Pacific (Taipei) Region Parameters: desyncMode Type: CSV Comma-separated list, in which customers can choose max 2 values among - '
ALB_DESYNC_MODE_CHECK.framework_control_requirement: Checks if an Application Load Balancer (ALB) is configured with a user defined desync mitigation mode. The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if ALB desync mitigation mode does not match with the user defined desync mitigation mode. Identifier: ALB_DESYNC_MODE_CHECK Resource Types: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer Trigger type: Configuration changes AWS Region: All supported AWS regions except Asia Pacific (New Zealand), Asia Pacific (Thailand), Mexico (Central), Asia Pacific (Taipei) Region Parameters: desyncMode Type: CSV Comma-separated list, in which customers can choose max 2 values among - '
ALB_DESYNC_MODE_CHECK.remediation_summary: Configure the resource to satisfy the rule ALB_DESYNC_MODE_CHECK. See the AWS Config developer guide for the rule for parameter details and specific remediation steps.
ALB_DESYNC_MODE_CHECK.title: Alb Desync Mode Check

ALB_HTTP_DROP_INVALID_HEADER_ENABLED.condition_description: Checks if rule evaluates AWS Application Load Balancers (ALB) to ensure they are configured to drop http headers. The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if the value of routing.http.drop_invalid_header_fields.enabled is set to false Identifier: ALB_HTTP_DROP_INVALID_HEADER_ENABLED Resource Types: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer Trigger type: Configuration changes AWS Region: All supported AWS regions Parameters: None
ALB_HTTP_DROP_INVALID_HEADER_ENABLED.framework_control_requirement: Checks if rule evaluates AWS Application Load Balancers (ALB) to ensure they are configured to drop http headers. The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if the value of routing.http.drop_invalid_header_fields.enabled is set to false Identifier: ALB_HTTP_DROP_INVALID_HEADER_ENABLED Resource Types: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer Trigger type: Configuration changes AWS Region: All supported AWS regions Parameters: None
ALB_HTTP_DROP_INVALID_HEADER_ENABLED.remediation_summary: Configure the resource to satisfy the rule ALB_HTTP_DROP_INVALID_HEADER_ENABLED. See the AWS Config developer guide for the rule for parameter details and specific remediation steps.
ALB_HTTP_DROP_INVALID_HEADER_ENABLED.title: Alb Http Drop Invalid Header Enabled

ALB_HTTP_TO_HTTPS_REDIRECTION_CHECK.condition_description: Periodic rule that fails any Application Load Balancer with HTTP listeners that do not perform a redirect to HTTPS or that forward to another HTTP listener instead of redirecting.
ALB_HTTP_TO_HTTPS_REDIRECTION_CHECK.framework_control_requirement: Checks if HTTP to HTTPS redirection is configured on all HTTP listeners of Application Load Balancers. The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if one or more HTTP listeners of Application Load Balancer do not have HTTP to HTTPS redirection configured. The rule is also NON_COMPLIANT if one of more HTTP listeners have forwarding to an HTTP listener instead of redirection.
ALB_HTTP_TO_HTTPS_REDIRECTION_CHECK.remediation_summary: Configure each ALB's HTTP listener default action to redirect to HTTPS (port 443) using aws elbv2 modify-listener with a redirect action (Status=HTTP_301) or Terraform aws_lb_listener.default_action { type = "redirect" redirect { port = "443" protocol = "HTTPS" status_code = "HTTP_301" } }. Ensure an HTTPS listener with a valid ACM certificate is also configured.
ALB_HTTP_TO_HTTPS_REDIRECTION_CHECK.title: Application Load Balancers must redirect HTTP to HTTPS

ALB_WAF_ENABLED.condition_description: Configuration-change rule that fails any Application Load Balancer not associated with an AWS WAF web ACL, and optionally fails ALBs not associated with a web ACL listed in wafWebAclIds.
ALB_WAF_ENABLED.condition_logic: alb.waf.enabled == true AND (wafWebAclIds == null OR alb.WebAclId IN wafWebAclIds)
ALB_WAF_ENABLED.framework_control_requirement: Checks if Web Application Firewall (WAF) is enabled on Application Load Balancers (ALBs). This rule is NON_COMPLIANT if key: waf.enabled is set to false.
ALB_WAF_ENABLED.remediation_summary: Associate each Application Load Balancer with an AWS WAF or WAFv2 web ACL via aws wafv2 associate-web-acl --resource-arn <alb-arn> --web-acl-arn <web-acl-arn>, or Terraform aws_wafv2_web_acl_association. Restrict the allow-list to ARNs in wafWebAclIds when the parameter is configured.
ALB_WAF_ENABLED.title: Application Load Balancers must be associated with an AWS WAF web ACL

API_GWV2_ACCESS_LOGS_ENABLED.condition_description: Configuration-change rule that fails any API Gateway V2 stage whose Stage configuration does not contain an accessLogSettings block.
API_GWV2_ACCESS_LOGS_ENABLED.framework_control_requirement: Checks if Amazon API Gateway V2 stages have access logging enabled. The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if 'accessLogSettings' is not present in Stage configuration.
API_GWV2_ACCESS_LOGS_ENABLED.remediation_summary: Enable access logging on each API Gateway V2 (HTTP/WebSocket) stage by setting AccessLogSettings.DestinationArn to a CloudWatch Logs log group ARN and Format to a $context.* template via aws apigatewayv2 update-stage or Terraform aws_apigatewayv2_stage.access_log_settings { destination_arn = ... format = ... }.
API_GWV2_ACCESS_LOGS_ENABLED.title: API Gateway V2 stages must have access logging enabled

API_GW_ASSOCIATED_WITH_WAF.condition_description: Configuration-change rule that fails any API Gateway REST API stage that is not associated with an AWS WAF web ACL, or is associated with a web ACL not in the WebAclArns allow list.
API_GW_ASSOCIATED_WITH_WAF.condition_logic: apigateway.Stage.WebAclArn != null AND (WebAclArns == null OR apigateway.Stage.WebAclArn IN WebAclArns)
API_GW_ASSOCIATED_WITH_WAF.framework_control_requirement: Checks if an Amazon API Gateway API stage is using an AWS WAF web access control list (web ACL). The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if an AWS WAF Web ACL is not used or if a used AWS Web ACL does not match what is listed in the rule parameter.
API_GW_ASSOCIATED_WITH_WAF.remediation_summary: Associate each API Gateway REST API stage with an AWS WAFv2 regional web ACL using aws wafv2 associate-web-acl --resource-arn arn:aws:apigateway:<region>::/restapis/<api-id>/stages/<stage> --web-acl-arn <web-acl-arn>, or Terraform aws_wafv2_web_acl_association. Restrict to ARNs listed in WebAclArns when the parameter is set.
API_GW_ASSOCIATED_WITH_WAF.title: API Gateway REST API stages must be associated with an AWS WAF web ACL

API_GW_CACHE_ENABLED_AND_ENCRYPTED.condition_description: Configuration-change rule that fails any API Gateway stage method whose CacheClusterEnabled is false or whose method-level CacheDataEncrypted is not set to true.
API_GW_CACHE_ENABLED_AND_ENCRYPTED.condition_logic: apigateway.Stage.CacheClusterEnabled == true AND all(method in apigateway.Stage.MethodSettings, method.CachingEnabled == true AND method.CacheDataEncrypted == true)
API_GW_CACHE_ENABLED_AND_ENCRYPTED.framework_control_requirement: Checks if all methods in Amazon API Gateway stages have cache enabled and cache encrypted. The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if any method in an Amazon API Gateway stage is not configured to cache or the cache is not encrypted.
API_GW_CACHE_ENABLED_AND_ENCRYPTED.remediation_summary: Enable caching at the stage level (cacheClusterEnabled = true) and, on every method in MethodSettings, set cachingEnabled = true and cacheDataEncrypted = true via aws apigateway update-stage or Terraform aws_api_gateway_method_settings.settings { caching_enabled = true cache_data_encrypted = true }.
API_GW_CACHE_ENABLED_AND_ENCRYPTED.title: API Gateway stage caches must be enabled and encrypted

API_GW_ENDPOINT_TYPE_CHECK.condition_description: Configuration-change rule that fails any API Gateway REST API whose endpointConfiguration.types do not match the values in the endpointConfigurationTypes parameter (allowed: REGIONAL, PRIVATE, EDGE).
API_GW_ENDPOINT_TYPE_CHECK.framework_control_requirement: Checks if Amazon API Gateway APIs are of the type specified in the rule parameter endpointConfigurationType. The rule returns NON_COMPLIANT if the REST API does not match the endpoint type configured in the rule parameter.
API_GW_ENDPOINT_TYPE_CHECK.remediation_summary: Re-create or update the REST API with the approved endpoint type (REGIONAL, PRIVATE, or EDGE) via aws apigateway update-rest-api --patch-operations op=replace,path=/endpointConfiguration/types/0,value=REGIONAL or Terraform aws_api_gateway_rest_api.endpoint_configuration { types = ["REGIONAL"] }.
API_GW_ENDPOINT_TYPE_CHECK.title: API Gateway REST APIs must use an approved endpoint type

API_GW_EXECUTION_LOGGING_ENABLED.condition_description: Configuration-change rule that fails any API Gateway / API Gateway V2 stage whose loggingLevel is OFF or whose level is not in the loggingLevel parameter (default ERROR or INFO).
API_GW_EXECUTION_LOGGING_ENABLED.framework_control_requirement: Checks if all methods in Amazon API Gateway stages have logging enabled. The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if logging is not enabled, or if loggingLevel is neither ERROR nor INFO.
API_GW_EXECUTION_LOGGING_ENABLED.remediation_summary: Enable execution logging on every API Gateway stage by setting MethodSettings */* loggingLevel to INFO or ERROR (and optionally dataTraceEnabled = true) via aws apigateway update-stage or Terraform aws_api_gateway_method_settings.settings { logging_level = "INFO" }, ensuring the API Gateway CloudWatch Logs role is configured at the account level.
API_GW_EXECUTION_LOGGING_ENABLED.title: API Gateway stages must have execution logging enabled

API_GW_SSL_ENABLED.condition_description: Configuration-change rule that fails any API Gateway REST API stage that does not have a client SSL certificate associated, or whose certificate ID is not in the optional CertificateIDs allow list.
API_GW_SSL_ENABLED.condition_logic: apigateway.Stage.ClientCertificateId != null AND (CertificateIDs == null OR apigateway.Stage.ClientCertificateId IN CertificateIDs)
API_GW_SSL_ENABLED.framework_control_requirement: Checks if a REST API stage uses an SSL certificate. The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if the REST API stage does not have an associated SSL certificate.
API_GW_SSL_ENABLED.remediation_summary: Generate or attach a client certificate to each REST API stage so backends can authenticate API Gateway as the caller. Use aws apigateway generate-client-certificate then aws apigateway update-stage --patch-operations op=replace,path=/clientCertificateId,value=<id>, or Terraform aws_api_gateway_client_certificate plus aws_api_gateway_stage.client_certificate_id.
API_GW_SSL_ENABLED.title: API Gateway REST API stages must have a client SSL certificate configured

API_GW_XRAY_ENABLED.condition_description: Configuration-change rule that fails any API Gateway REST API stage whose TracingEnabled flag is not true.
API_GW_XRAY_ENABLED.framework_control_requirement: Checks if AWS X-Ray tracing is enabled on Amazon API Gateway REST APIs. The rule is COMPLIANT if X-Ray tracing is enabled and NON_COMPLIANT otherwise.
API_GW_XRAY_ENABLED.remediation_summary: Turn on X-Ray active tracing for each REST API stage via aws apigateway update-stage --patch-operations op=replace,path=/tracingEnabled,value=true, or Terraform aws_api_gateway_stage.xray_tracing_enabled = true. Ensure the API Gateway invocation role allows xray:PutTraceSegments.
API_GW_XRAY_ENABLED.title: API Gateway REST API stages must have AWS X-Ray tracing enabled

APPSYNC_ASSOCIATED_WITH_WAF.condition_description: Periodic rule that fails any AWS AppSync GraphQL API not associated with an AWS WAFv2 web ACL, and optionally fails APIs whose web ACL ARN is not in wafWebAclARNs.
APPSYNC_ASSOCIATED_WITH_WAF.condition_logic: appsync.GraphQLApi.WafWebAclArn != null AND (wafWebAclARNs == null OR appsync.GraphQLApi.WafWebAclArn IN wafWebAclARNs)
APPSYNC_ASSOCIATED_WITH_WAF.framework_control_requirement: Checks if AWS AppSync APIs are associated with AWS WAFv2 web access control lists (ACLs). The rule is NON_COMPLIANT for an AWS AppSync API if it is not associated with a web ACL.
APPSYNC_ASSOCIATED_WITH_WAF.remediation_summary: Attach an AWS WAFv2 regional web ACL to each AppSync GraphQL API via aws wafv2 associate-web-acl --resource-arn <appsync-api-arn> --web-acl-arn <web-acl-arn>, or Terraform aws_wafv2_web_acl_association. Restrict associations to the ARNs listed in wafWebAclARNs when configured.
APPSYNC_ASSOCIATED_WITH_WAF.title: AWS AppSync GraphQL APIs must be associated with an AWS WAF web ACL

APPSYNC_LOGGING_ENABLED.condition_description: Configuration-change rule that fails any AWS AppSync GraphQL API whose logConfig.fieldLogLevel is NONE, or whose log level does not match the values in the fieldLoggingLevel parameter.
APPSYNC_LOGGING_ENABLED.framework_control_requirement: Checks if an AWS AppSync API has field level logging enabled. The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if field level logging is not enabled, or if the field logging levels for the AppSync API do not match the values specified in the fieldLoggingLevel parameter.
APPSYNC_LOGGING_ENABLED.remediation_summary: Enable field-level logging on each AppSync API by setting logConfig.fieldLogLevel to ERROR or ALL and providing a CloudWatch Logs IAM role via aws appsync update-graphql-api or Terraform aws_appsync_graphql_api.log_config { field_log_level = "ERROR" cloudwatch_logs_role_arn = ... }.
APPSYNC_LOGGING_ENABLED.title: AWS AppSync GraphQL APIs must have field-level logging enabled

ATHENA_WORKGROUP_ENCRYPTED_AT_REST.condition_description: Configuration-change rule that fails any Athena workgroup whose ResultConfiguration.EncryptionConfiguration is not enabled (i.e., encryption option is null).
ATHENA_WORKGROUP_ENCRYPTED_AT_REST.framework_control_requirement: Checks if an Amazon Athena workgroup is encrypted at rest. The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if encryption of data at rest is not enabled for an Athena workgroup.
ATHENA_WORKGROUP_ENCRYPTED_AT_REST.remediation_summary: Configure encryption at rest on each Athena workgroup's ResultConfiguration by selecting SSE_S3, SSE_KMS, or CSE_KMS via aws athena update-work-group --configuration-updates ResultConfigurationUpdates={EncryptionConfiguration={EncryptionOption=SSE_KMS,KmsKey=<arn>}}, or Terraform aws_athena_workgroup.configuration.result_configuration.encryption_configuration { encryption_option = "SSE_KMS" kms_key_arn = ... }.
ATHENA_WORKGROUP_ENCRYPTED_AT_REST.title: Athena workgroups must encrypt query results at rest

AURORA_RESOURCES_PROTECTED_BY_BACKUP_PLA.condition_description: Periodic rule that verifies each Aurora RDS DB cluster (optionally filtered by tags or resourceId) is referenced by an active AWS Backup plan, and optionally that the backup vault is locked with retention within minRetentionDays/maxRetentionDays.
AURORA_RESOURCES_PROTECTED_BY_BACKUP_PLA.condition_logic: rds_db_cluster IN aws_backup_plan.resource_assignments AND (backupVaultLockCheck != 'True' OR vault.lock.retention_days BETWEEN minRetentionDays AND maxRetentionDays)
AURORA_RESOURCES_PROTECTED_BY_BACKUP_PLA.framework_control_requirement: Checks if Amazon Aurora DB clusters are protected by a backup plan. The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if the Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) Database Cluster is not protected by a backup plan.
AURORA_RESOURCES_PROTECTED_BY_BACKUP_PLA.remediation_summary: Add the Aurora DB cluster to an AWS Backup plan with a tag-based or resource-based selection. Use AWS Backup console, aws backup create-backup-selection, or Terraform aws_backup_selection / aws_backup_plan to ensure the cluster is covered, and configure a locked Backup Vault if retention guarantees are required.
AURORA_RESOURCES_PROTECTED_BY_BACKUP_PLA.title: Aurora DB clusters must be protected by an AWS Backup plan

AUTOSCALING_GROUP_ELB_HEALTHCHECK_REQUIR.condition_description: Configuration-change rule that fails any EC2 Auto Scaling group attached to a Classic ELB or target group when the group's HealthCheckType is not ELB.
AUTOSCALING_GROUP_ELB_HEALTHCHECK_REQUIR.framework_control_requirement: Checks if your Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling groups that are associated with an Elastic Load Balancer use Elastic Load Balancing health checks. The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if the Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling groups are not using Elastic Load Balancing health checks.
AUTOSCALING_GROUP_ELB_HEALTHCHECK_REQUIR.remediation_summary: Switch each Auto Scaling group attached to an ELB or ALB/NLB target group to ELB health checks via aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --health-check-type ELB --health-check-grace-period <seconds>, or Terraform aws_autoscaling_group.health_check_type = "ELB".
AUTOSCALING_GROUP_ELB_HEALTHCHECK_REQUIR.title: Auto Scaling groups attached to load balancers must use ELB health checks

AUTOSCALING_LAUNCHCONFIG_REQUIRES_IMDSV2.condition_description: Configuration-change rule that fails any EC2 Auto Scaling launch configuration whose MetadataOptions.HttpTokens is not 'required' (or is missing), allowing IMDSv1 use.
AUTOSCALING_LAUNCHCONFIG_REQUIRES_IMDSV2.framework_control_requirement: Checks whether only IMDSv2 is enabled. This rule is NON_COMPLIANT if the Metadata version is not included in the launch configuration or if both Metadata V1 and V2 are enabled.
AUTOSCALING_LAUNCHCONFIG_REQUIRES_IMDSV2.remediation_summary: Recreate the launch configuration with MetadataOptions.HttpTokens = required (and HttpEndpoint = enabled) via aws autoscaling create-launch-configuration --metadata-options HttpTokens=required,HttpEndpoint=enabled, or Terraform aws_launch_configuration.metadata_options { http_tokens = "required" http_endpoint = "enabled" }. Roll the change into the Auto Scaling group with an instance refresh.
AUTOSCALING_LAUNCHCONFIG_REQUIRES_IMDSV2.title: Auto Scaling launch configurations must enforce IMDSv2

AUTOSCALING_LAUNCH_CONFIG_PUBLIC_IP_DISA.condition_description: Configuration-change rule that fails any EC2 Auto Scaling launch configuration whose AssociatePublicIpAddress is set to true, exposing instances launched with the configuration to the public internet.
AUTOSCALING_LAUNCH_CONFIG_PUBLIC_IP_DISA.framework_control_requirement: Checks if Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling groups have public IP addresses enabled through Launch Configurations. The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if the Launch Configuration for an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group has AssociatePublicIpAddress set to 'true'.
AUTOSCALING_LAUNCH_CONFIG_PUBLIC_IP_DISA.remediation_summary: Recreate the launch configuration with AssociatePublicIpAddress = false (or omit it) using aws autoscaling create-launch-configuration --no-associate-public-ip-address, or Terraform aws_launch_configuration.associate_public_ip_address = false. Use private subnets and a NAT gateway for outbound access.
AUTOSCALING_LAUNCH_CONFIG_PUBLIC_IP_DISA.title: Auto Scaling launch configurations must not assign public IPs

BACKUP_PLAN_MIN_FREQUENCY_AND_MIN_RETENT.condition_description: Configuration-change rule that fails any AWS Backup plan whose backup rules do not run at least as frequently as requiredFrequencyValue/Unit (default every 1 day) or whose retention is shorter than requiredRetentionDays (default 35 days).
BACKUP_PLAN_MIN_FREQUENCY_AND_MIN_RETENT.framework_control_requirement: Checks if a backup plan has a backup rule that satisfies the required frequency and retention period. The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if recovery points are not created at least as often as the specified frequency or expire before the specified period.
BACKUP_PLAN_MIN_FREQUENCY_AND_MIN_RETENT.remediation_summary: Edit each AWS Backup plan rule so the schedule cron / rate runs at or above requiredFrequencyValue and the lifecycle DeleteAfterDays meets requiredRetentionDays, via aws backup update-backup-plan or Terraform aws_backup_plan.rule { schedule = "cron(0 5 * * ? *)" lifecycle { delete_after = 35 } }.
BACKUP_PLAN_MIN_FREQUENCY_AND_MIN_RETENT.title: AWS Backup plans must meet minimum frequency and retention requirements

BACKUP_RECOVERY_POINT_ENCRYPTED.condition_description: Configuration-change rule that fails any AWS Backup recovery point whose IsEncrypted attribute is false.
BACKUP_RECOVERY_POINT_ENCRYPTED.framework_control_requirement: Checks if a recovery point is encrypted. The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if the recovery point is not encrypted.
BACKUP_RECOVERY_POINT_ENCRYPTED.remediation_summary: Ensure source resources (EBS, RDS, EFS, DynamoDB, etc.) are encrypted before AWS Backup creates recovery points, or store recovery points in an AWS Backup vault that has an EncryptionKeyArn configured. Configure the vault with aws backup create-backup-vault --encryption-key-arn <kms-arn> or Terraform aws_backup_vault.kms_key_arn.
BACKUP_RECOVERY_POINT_ENCRYPTED.title: AWS Backup recovery points must be encrypted

BACKUP_RECOVERY_POINT_MANUAL_DELETION_DI.condition_description: Configuration-change rule that inspects each AWS Backup vault's resource-based access policy. The vault is non-compliant unless its policy contains a Deny statement covering backup:DeleteRecoveryPoint, backup:UpdateRecoveryPointLifecycle, and backup:PutBackupVaultAccessPolicy with wildcard Principal and Resource.
BACKUP_RECOVERY_POINT_MANUAL_DELETION_DI.condition_logic: backup_vault.access_policy.Statement contains { Effect == 'Deny' AND Action superset_of ['backup:DeleteRecoveryPoint','backup:UpdateRecoveryPointLifecycle','backup:PutBackupVaultAccessPolicy'] AND Principal == '*' AND Resource == '*' }
BACKUP_RECOVERY_POINT_MANUAL_DELETION_DI.framework_control_requirement: Checks if a backup vault has an attached resource-based policy which prevents deletion of recovery points. The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if the Backup Vault does not have resource-based policies or has policies without a suitable 'Deny' statement (statement with backup:DeleteRecoveryPoint, backup:UpdateRecoveryPointLifecycle, and backup:PutBackupVaultAccessPolicy permissions).
BACKUP_RECOVERY_POINT_MANUAL_DELETION_DI.remediation_summary: Attach a resource-based access policy to each AWS Backup vault that explicitly denies backup:DeleteRecoveryPoint, backup:UpdateRecoveryPointLifecycle, and backup:PutBackupVaultAccessPolicy with Principal '*' and Resource '*' (optionally exempting trusted ARNs via principalArnList). Apply via aws backup put-backup-vault-access-policy or Terraform aws_backup_vault_policy.
BACKUP_RECOVERY_POINT_MANUAL_DELETION_DI.title: AWS Backup vaults must block manual deletion of recovery points

BACKUP_RECOVERY_POINT_MINIMUM_RETENTION_.condition_description: Checks if a recovery point expires no earlier than after the specified period. The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if the recovery point has a retention point that is less than the required retention period. Identifier: BACKUP_RECOVERY_POINT_MINIMUM_RETENTION_CHECK Resource Types: AWS::Backup::RecoveryPoint Trigger type: Configuration changes AWS Region: All supported AWS regions except Asia Pacific (New Zealand), China (Beijing), Asia Pacific (Thailand), Asia Pacific (Malaysia), Mexico (Central), Israel (Tel Aviv), Asia Pacific (Taipei), Canada West (Calgary), China (Ningxia) Region Parameters: require
BACKUP_RECOVERY_POINT_MINIMUM_RETENTION_.framework_control_requirement: Checks if a recovery point expires no earlier than after the specified period. The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if the recovery point has a retention point that is less than the required retention period. BEANSTALK_ENHANCED_HEALTH_REPORTING_ENAB.condition_description: Checks if an AWS Elastic Beanstalk environment is configured for enhanced health reporting. The rule is COMPLIANT if the environment is configured for enhanced health reporting. The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if the environment is configured for basic health reporting. Identifier: BEANSTALK_ENHANCED_HEALTH_REPORTING_ENABLED Resource Types: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment Trigger type: Configuration changes AWS Region: All supported AWS regions except Mexico (Central), Israel (Tel Aviv), Asia Pacific (Taipei) Region Parameters: None
BEANSTALK_ENHANCED_HEALTH_REPORTING_ENAB.framework_control_requirement: Checks if an AWS Elastic Beanstalk environment is configured for enhanced health reporting. The rule is COMPLIANT if the environment is configured for enhanced health reporting. The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if the environment is configured for basic health reporting. Identifier: BEANSTALK_ENHANCED_HEALTH_REPORTING_ENABLED Resource Types: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment Trigger type: Configuration changes AWS Region: All supported AWS regions except Mexico (Central), Israel (Tel Aviv), Asia Pacific (Taipei) Region Parameters: None
BEANSTALK_ENHANCED_HEALTH_REPORTING_ENAB.remediation_summary: Configure the resource to satisfy the rule BEANSTALK_ENHANCED_HEALTH_REPORTING_ENABLED. See the AWS Config developer guide for the rule for parameter details and specific remediation steps.

Identifier: CLB_DESYNC_MODE_CHECK Resource Types: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancing::LoadBalancer Trigger type: Configuration changes AWS Region: All supported AWS regions except Asia Pacific (New Zealand), Asia Pacific (Thailand), Middle East (UAE), Asia Pacific (Hyderabad), Asia Pacific (Malaysia), Asia Pacific (Melbourne), Mexico (Central), Israel (Tel Aviv), Asia Pacific (Taipei), Canada We

CLB_MULTIPLE_AZ.condition_description: Checks if a Classic Load Balancer spans multiple Availability Zones (AZs). The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if a Classic Load Balancer spans less than 2 AZs or does not span number of AZs mentioned in the minAvailabilityZones parameter (if provided). Identifier: CLB_MULTIPLE_AZ Resource Types: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancing::LoadBalancer Trigger type: Configuration changes AWS Region: All supported AWS regions except Asia Pacific (New Zealand), Asia Pacific (Thailand), AWS GovCloud (US-East), AWS GovCloud (US-West), Mexico (Central), Asia Pacific (Taipei) Region Parameters: minAvailabilityZones (Optional)
CLB_MULTIPLE_AZ.framework_control_requirement: Checks if a Classic Load Balancer spans multiple Availability Zones (AZs). The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if a Classic Load Balancer spans less than 2 AZs or does not span number of AZs mentioned in the minAvailabilityZones parameter (if provided). Identifier: CLB_MULTIPLE_AZ Resource Types: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancing::LoadBalancer Trigger type: Configuration changes AWS Region: All supported AWS regions except Asia Pacific (New Zealand), Asia Pacific (Thailand), AWS GovCloud (US-East), AWS GovCloud (US-West), Mexico (Central), Asia Pacific (Taipei) Region Parameters: minAvailabilityZones (Optional)
CLB_MULTIPLE_AZ.remediation_summary: Configure the resource to satisfy the rule CLB_MULTIPLE_AZ. See the AWS Config developer guide for the rule for parameter details and specific remediation steps.
